issue.title: chore(deps): upgrade `node-fetch`
issue.body:
Fixes #33462 

Tried upgrading to v3, but we rely on the `timeout` property:

https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/e5dee17f776dcc79ebb269f7b7341fa6e2b6c3f1/packages/next/telemetry/post-payload.ts#L12

Which was removed since it's non-standard:

https://github.com/node-fetch/node-fetch/blob/main/docs/v3-UPGRADE-GUIDE.md#the-timeout-option-was-removed

I wanted to keep this PR minimal, so I did not try to work around the above.

## Documentation / Examples

body: @balazsorban44 / @kodiakhq did we fix this for `next 11.x` version as well? Is that in the plan?

We likely won't backport it since you can update `node-fetch` in v11 with [overrides](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v8/configuring-npm/package-json#overrides) for npm or [resolutions](https://classic.yarnpkg.com/lang/en/docs/selective-version-resolutions/) for yarn. `node-fetch` wasn't precompiled in `11.1.3`

> We likely won't backport it since you can update `node-fetch` in v11 with [overrides](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v8/configuring-npm/package-json#overrides) for npm or [resolutions](https://classic.yarnpkg.com/lang/en/docs/selective-version-resolutions/) for yarn. `node-fetch` wasn't precompiled in `11.1.3`

@balazsorban44 , `overrides` is introduced with `npm 8.3.0`. What about if npm < `8.3.0` ? As this `security` vulnerability, why can't it get patched in `11.x`? Is `11.x` will not be maintained further?
On reconsideration, we might do it after all, thank you for pointing it out.

labels.name: bug

issue.body:

      next: 12.0.8

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.15.3

### What browser are you using?

Chrome

### What operating system are you using?

Windows

### How are you deploying your application?

S3

### Describe the Bug

This morning(1/26/2022) I created a brand new nextjs app with this command `npx create-next-app@latest`, at the end of the run I saw the following message about a vulnerability
```
found 1 high severity vulnerability
run `npm audit fix` to fix them, or `npm audit` for details
```
Here is the result from `npm audit`

```
                       === npm audit security report ===


                                 Manual Review
             Some vulnerabilities require your attention to resolve

          Visit https://go.npm.me/audit-guide for additional guidance


  High            node-fetch is vulnerable to Exposure of Sensitive
                  Information to an Unauthorized Actor

  Package         node-fetch

  Patched in      >=2.6.7

  Dependency of   next

  Path            next > node-fetch

  More info       https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r683-j2x4-v87g

found 1 high severity vulnerability in 256 scanned packages
  1 vulnerability requires manual review. See the full report for details.
```

### Expected Behavior

It should not have high severity vulnerability when you create a brand new app.

### To Reproduce

- Run `npx create-next-app@latest`
- Give a name
- After app is created navigate to that folder in command line
- Run `npm audit`
- You should see the follwing message
